title: Gaussian Process Stochastic Frontiers with Two-Way Fixed Effects
abstract: arXiv:2611.34081v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parametric frontier restrictions and unobserved time heterogeneity can distort efficiency measurement in panel data. This paper develops a Bayesian stochastic frontier model with a Gaussian process prior and unrestricted individual and time effects that may be correlated with inputs. Conditional on inefficiency, orthogonal projection eliminates both sets of fixed effects, yielding a restricted likelihood that retains observation-specific inefficiency. Monte Carlo experiments show competitive performance under correct parametric specification and improved performance when benchmark models impose an incorrect frontier functional form or omit time effects. An application to Spanish dairy farms observed from 1999 to 2010 yields similar average technical efficiency across specifications, but a lower posterior mean of average returns to scale, with greater uncertainty, under the Gaussian process frontier. translated_title: 具有双向固定效应的高斯过程随机前沿模型
translated_abstract: 参数化前沿的约束形式和未被观测的时间异质性可能会扭曲面板数据中的效率测量。本文开发了一种贝叶斯随机前沿模型，该模型采用高斯过程先验，并包含可能与投入变量相关的不受限制的个体效应和时间效应。在给定无效率项的条件下，正交投影可消除这两组固定效应，从而得到一个保留观测个体特定无效率信息的受限似然函数。蒙特卡洛实验表明，在参数设定正确时该模型表现具有竞争力；而当基准模型施加了错误的前沿函数形式或忽略了时间效应时，该模型的表现则有所提升。对1999年至2010年西班牙奶牛场的应用分析显示，不同设定下的平均技术效率相近，但在高斯过程前沿下，平均规模报酬的后验均值更低且不确定性更大。包含年度效应的模型还得出……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种带双向固定效应的高斯过程贝叶斯随机前沿模型，通过正交投影消除与投入相关的个体和时间固定效应并保留个体无效率信息，从而在前沿函数形式设定错误或存在时间异质性时显著提升效率测量的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian stochastic frontier model with a Gaussian process prior and two-way fixed effects, using orthogonal projection to eliminate individual and time effects correlated with inputs while retaining observation-specific inefficiency, thereby improving efficiency measurement when frontier functional forms are misspecified or time heterogeneity is omitted.
